`pack.toml`: a pack's name, version and permissions.

Editors can complete and check this file with its JSON Schema, [`pack.schema.json`](https://github.com/TuentyFaiv/cuilo/blob/main/schemas/pack.schema.json).

## Fields

### `description`

**Type:** `string` · optional

One-line summary.

### `kinds`

**Type:** `array of string` · optional

What the pack is for, as many as apply: `ui`, `backend`, `mobile` or `desktop`, each once, e.g.
`["ui", "mobile"]`. The pack directory lists the pack under each kind.

### `license`

**Type:** `string` · optional

SPDX license expression.

### `migrations`

**Type:** `array of object` · optional

Code changes applied when an update crosses a version.

#### `migrations[].ast_grep`

**Type:** `string` · optional

An ast-grep rule file in the pack, e.g. `migrations/2.0.0.yml`; needs the `ast-grep` program.

#### `migrations[].description`

**Type:** `string` · required

What it changes, for the plan.

#### `migrations[].files`

**Type:** `array of string` · required

Project files it runs on; they must also be in `permissions.write`.

#### `migrations[].rename`

**Type:** `object` · optional

Renames an identifier, matching whole words only.

##### `migrations[].rename.from`

**Type:** `string` · required

Identifier to replace.

##### `migrations[].rename.to`

**Type:** `string` · required

Its replacement.

#### `migrations[].to`

**Type:** `string` · required

Runs when updating from a version below this one to this one or later.

### `name`

**Type:** `string` · required

Lowercase letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter.

### `permissions`

**Type:** `object` · optional

What the pack may do in a project.

Default: `{"write":[]}`.

#### `permissions.commands`

**Type:** `array of string` · optional

External commands the pack may run.

#### `permissions.dependencies`

**Type:** `boolean` · optional

Whether the pack may add dependencies.

#### `permissions.write`

**Type:** `array of string` · optional

Paths the pack may create or modify.

Default: `[]`.

### `schema_version`

**Type:** `number` · required

Manifest format version; must be `1`.

### `translations`

**Type:** `map of object` · optional

The pack's text in other languages, by locale, e.g. `[translations.es-mx]`. Readers in that locale see it,
and the English text where it gives none.

#### `translations.<key>.description`

**Type:** `string` · optional

The pack's `description` in this locale; the pack must have a `description`.

### `version`

**Type:** `string` · required

Semantic version of the pack.
